Post 1

📉 New 20-day high, then a selloff. ASX 200 closed at 9,020.80, down 44.30pts or 0.49%. Materials cratered 2.51% and dragged the index lower even as banks held firm. The bull run hit a wall. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Materials worst sector, down 2.51%. Consumer Staples led gains at +1.41%, Financials added 0.55%. Classic risk-off rotation — defensives bid, cyclicals sold. Tells you the market is not fully convinced. #ASX #mining #ausbiz

Post 3

NEC surged 11.64% to AUD 0.815 while NWS shed 9.29% to AUD 43.07. Two media names, opposite directions, same session. The divergence inside one sector rarely lies. #ASX #media #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 5,885.60/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6888. A soft local currency keeps gold elevated in AUD terms — materials stocks fell anyway, showing commodity prices alone don't save miners. #ASX #gold #commodities

Post 5

ASX sits 2.97% off its 52-week high after a 1.27% weekly gain. Can buyers defend 9,000? That level is the line. What's your call heading into next week — retest or breakout? #ASX #ausbiz #investing
